biotools.summary: Demultiplexing and filtering utilities intended for reads with combinatorial barcodes (i.e. PETRI-seq and SPLiT-seq). The demultiplexer algorithm uses the position of the segments to extract and compare the barcodes with the reference (whitelist). A Shiny application is provided to interactively select cutoffs for which barcode combinations to keep.
